bmesh.new.description: Create a standalone editable mesh, use_operators=True/False

bmesh.ops.bevel.description: All edges of a closed convex mesh, OFFSET, profile 0.5, 1..8 segments and nonoverlapping width; canonical cuboids retain uniform-face requirements; return beveled faces/all new edges and vertices, invalidate old handles; no-op empty or zero offset

bmesh.ops.bisect_plane.description: Finite plane, selected vertices/edges/faces, single-segment polygon cuts, snap-center and clear-inner/outer; preserve surviving handles and return geom/geom_cut; 100,000 vertices/faces

bmesh.ops.create_circle.description: Circle creation with optional 3x3/4x4 matrix; no editable UV layers

bmesh.ops.create_cone.description: Cone creation with optional 3x3/4x4 matrix; no editable UV layers

bmesh.ops.create_cube.description: Cube creation with optional 3x3/4x4 matrix; no editable UV layers

bmesh.ops.create_grid.description: Grid creation with optional 3x3/4x4 matrix; no editable UV layers

bmesh.ops.create_uvsphere.description: UV-sphere creation with optional 3x3/4x4 matrix; no editable UV layers

bmesh.ops.delete.description: Delete selected VERTS, EDGES, FACES_ONLY geometry

bmesh.ops.extrude_face_region.description: Extrude manifold face regions or mixed vertices/edges/faces, wire edges and isolated vertices with default flags; mixed faces require one connected region and retained attached caps require flat incident faces; use_keep_orig controls attached input cap removal; return duplicated vertices/edges/caps; stable indices and wall order can differ from Blender

bmesh.ops.inset_region.description: Noncollapsing planar manifold face regions, thickness/depth, boundary and even-offset modes; retain input face handles, return rim faces; no relative offset, edge rail or outset

bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals.description: Orient selected faces using complete connected manifold components with planar faces; closed components use signed volume, open components use extremal-corner orientation; refresh all normals without topology reordering; degenerate/non-orientable/non-manifold inputs rejected

bmesh.ops.remove_doubles.description: Merge selected vertices using Blender-compatible float32 spatial representatives and distance boundaries; remove duplicate/collapsed edges and faces, split repeated-corner polygons, retain target coordinates; returns None

bmesh.ops.rotate.description: Rotate selected editable vertices about a center with 3x3/4x4 matrices and nonsingular space; use_shapekey optionally transforms all shape layers

bmesh.ops.scale.description: Scale editable vertices in nonsingular 3x3/4x4 space; returns None

bmesh.ops.solidify.description: Finite positive/negative/zero thickness; oriented manifold face shells with miter offsets, edge and vertex selections; retain original handles, return new shell vertices/edges/caps; 100,000 vertices/faces

bmesh.ops.subdivide_edges.description: Linear cuts 0..64: complete triangle/quad grids, unfilled whole/one-edge boundaries, adjacent quad corner cuts and wires; preserve original handles and return geom_inner/geom_split/geom; no smoothing/fractal options

bmesh.ops.transform.description: Apply a 3x3/4x4 affine transform in nonsingular space; use_shapekey optionally transforms all shape layers

bmesh.ops.translate.description: Translate editable vertices in nonsingular 3x3/4x4 space; returns None

bmesh.ops.triangulate.description: Planar simple faces, up to 2048 corners: BEAUTY/FIXED/ALTERNATE/SHORT_EDGE/LONG_EDGE quads and BEAUTY/EAR_CLIP n-gons; retain original face handle, copy attributes, return edges/faces/face_map/face_map_double; 100,000 faces

bmesh.types.BMEdge.index.description: Read or write a valid edge index; normal repair refreshes sequential indices without reordering edges

bmesh.types.BMEdge.is_valid.description: Edge handle validity, including after BMesh.free

bmesh.types.BMFace.index.description: Read or write a valid face index; normal repair refreshes sequential indices without reordering faces

bmesh.types.BMFace.is_valid.description: Face handle validity, including after BMesh.free

bmesh.types.BMLayerCollection.get.description: Find a layer by name with optional default

bmesh.types.BMLayerCollection.new.description: Create a named layer; UV/shape defaults zero, FLOAT_COLOR defaults white; duplicate names rejected

bmesh.types.BMLayerCollection.remove.description: Remove this collection layer and invalidate its handle

bmesh.types.BMLayerCollection.verify.description: Return active layer or create a default-named layer

bmesh.types.BMLayerItem.name.description: Read layer name; reject removed/freed layer handles

bmesh.types.BMLoopUV.uv.description: Read/write finite float32 UV pair through loop[layer].uv

bmesh.types.BMesh.edges.new.description: Add an edge between distinct vertices

bmesh.types.BMesh.faces.new.description: Add a face using distinct vertices

bmesh.types.BMesh.faces.remove.description: Remove face, retaining edges and vertices

bmesh.types.BMesh.free.description: Invalidate the editable mesh and its elements

bmesh.types.BMesh.from_mesh.description: Append plain geometry; import UV, FLOAT_COLOR, shape and unchanged packed-normal data into an empty BMesh

bmesh.types.BMesh.loops.layers.uv.description: Up to eight editable corner UV layers

bmesh.types.BMesh.to_mesh.description: Atomically publish geometry and supported editable layers; packed normals require flat faces and unchanged geometry

bmesh.types.BMesh.verts.layers.shape.description: Up to 64 relative shape layers; mesh key data requires a target with shape keys

bmesh.types.BMesh.verts.new.description: Add a vertex with a 3D coordinate

bpy.context.collection.objects.link.description: Link an existing object to the active collection

bpy.context.mode.description: Transient construction context: OBJECT or EDIT_MESH

bpy.context.scene.cursor.description: Transient construction cursor; initialized at zero each script run

bpy.data.collections.description: Collections, excluding the scene master collection

bpy.data.curves.description: Legacy Curve database distinct from meshes; iteration, integer/name lookup, get/new/remove; data persists with evaluated surface cache

bpy.data.curves.new.description: new(name, type=CURVE or FONT); POLY/BEZIER curves require dimensions=3D; FONT is the explicitly loaded static TrueType text subset

bpy.data.curves.remove.description: Remove curve data with normal data-user unlink semantics

bpy.data.fonts.load.description: load(filepath, check_existing=False); static glyf-based TrueType <=4 MiB with Unicode cmap format 4; parsed printable ASCII outlines persist once in the scene; CFF/variable/composite glyphs excluded

bpy.data.images.new.description: new(name, width, height, alpha=True, float_buffer=False, stereo3d=False, is_data=False, tiled=False); non-tiled mono images

bpy.data.lights.new.description: new(name, type): POINT, SUN, SPOT, AREA

bpy.data.meshes.description: Mesh data blocks: iteration, lookup and creation

bpy.data.objects.description: Object database: iteration, length, name/index lookup, get

bpy.data.objects.new.description: new(name, object_data): mesh, camera, light or None

bpy.data.textures.remove.description: Remove textures and unlink modifier users

bpy.data.worlds.get.description: Look up a World by name

bpy.data.worlds.new.description: Create a named World with constant-color settings

bpy.data.worlds.remove.description: Remove a World and unlink scene users

bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf.description: GLB or GLTF_SEPARATE export; selection, applied modifiers, optional cameras/lights; each output file atomically replaced, no cross-file transaction

bpy.ops.export_scene.obj.description: Legacy OBJ/MTL mesh export: selection, applied modifiers, normals, UVs, triangulation, signed axis pair and positive scale; scalar Principled factors and base/alpha/normal images; per-file atomic writes

bpy.ops.import_scene.gltf.description: Import GLB/glTF into the active collection, select imported objects and preserve hierarchy; file vertex indexing, scalar Principled material inputs and native asset bindings; arbitrary generated shader graphs are not reconstructed

bpy.ops.import_scene.obj.description: Legacy Blender 3.6 OBJ operator: split named objects, declared forward/up axes, faces, UVs, normals, smoothing and scalar MTL; imported selection retains the previous active object

bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_circle_add.description: WORLD/CURSOR circle in object or single-mesh EDIT construction; vertices/radius, NOTHING/NGON/TRIFAN; construction scale ignored; zero radius requires calc_uvs=False

bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cone_add.description: WORLD/CURSOR cone/frustum in object or single-mesh EDIT construction; vertices/radii/depth and caps, finite degenerate wire geometry; explicit positive/zero scale and optional UVs; negative scale requires calc_uvs=False

bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add.description: Keyword-only cube size/location/rotation/scale; WORLD or CURSOR, object or single-mesh EDIT construction; explicit zero size uses unit cube; return to OBJECT before script completion

bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add.description: WORLD/CURSOR cylinder in object or single-mesh EDIT construction; vertices/radius/depth, NGON/TRIFAN/NOTHING caps, finite degenerate wire geometry; explicit scale including zero; negative scale requires calc_uvs=False

bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_ico_sphere_add.description: WORLD/CURSOR ico sphere in object or single-mesh EDIT construction; subdivisions 1..7, radius including zero, explicit scale including zero, optional seam UVs; equivalent indexed topology

bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_plane_add.description: WORLD/CURSOR plane in object or single-mesh EDIT construction; size including zero, location/rotation, optional UVs; construction scale ignored

bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_torus_add.description: WORLD/CURSOR torus in object or existing single-mesh EDIT context; segments 3..256, MAJOR_MINOR or EXT_INT, 0 <= minor <= major including zero, optional UVs; self-intersecting radii excluded

bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add.description: WORLD/CURSOR UV sphere in object or single-mesh EDIT construction; segments/rings/radius, explicit scale including zero; zero radius requires calc_uvs=False and keeps an unmerged quad grid; construction limit 100000 vertices

bpy.ops.object.camera_add.description: Create a camera in object mode with WORLD alignment; input scale is ignored, matching Blender.

bpy.ops.object.delete.description: Delete selected objects in the scene; use_global supported

bpy.ops.object.duplicate.description: Duplicate selected objects with linked=False/True; preserve collection links, copied-data sharing, modifiers and selection, and remap selected parents; default TRANSLATION mode

bpy.ops.object.editmode_toggle.description: No arguments; toggle OBJECT/EDIT primitive construction on one selected active mesh, returning FINISHED; same geometry/context limits as mode_set; finish in OBJECT mode

bpy.ops.object.empty_add.description: Create non-image empty object display shapes; radius sets display size.

bpy.ops.object.join.description: Join selected meshes using world transforms, including reflections, shared data and direct hierarchy relations; update all active-data users, detach removed-source children; UV/material slots retained; no modifiers or other indexed custom attributes

bpy.ops.object.light_add.description: Create POINT/SUN/SPOT/AREA lights; AREA radius sets size, input scale is ignored.

bpy.ops.object.mode_set.description: Transient OBJECT/EDIT primitive construction on one selected active mesh; toggle=False; return to OBJECT before object operations or script completion; combined edit construction at most 100000 vertices/faces with ordinary geometry/materials/UVs

bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply.description: Apply the first supported modifier to an active single-user mesh

bpy.ops.object.origin_set.description: Selected meshes: ORIGIN_GEOMETRY or GEOMETRY_ORIGIN, MEDIAN or BOUNDS center; preserve dependent children for nonsingular transforms; shift shared mesh data once, leaving unselected users' transforms unchanged

bpy.ops.object.parent_set.description: Parent selected children to the active object; type=OBJECT, keep_transform False/True, inverse-parent compensation and cycle rejection; nonsingular parent transform

bpy.ops.object.select_all.description: action: SELECT, DESELECT, INVERT or TOGGLE

bpy.ops.object.shade_flat.description: Set mesh polygons to flat shading

bpy.ops.object.shade_smooth.description: Set mesh polygons to smooth shading

bpy.ops.object.text_add.description: Object-mode Text creation; WORLD/CURSOR alignment, location/rotation and unit construction scale; assign an explicit static TrueType font before update/export/script completion; no edit lifecycle

bpy.ops.object.transform_apply.description: Bake selected TRS mesh transforms with nonzero scales, including reflections and child compensation; isolate_users False/True, transform shared data once when all users selected; shared selected users must be unparented without children; no shape keys or reflected packed normals

bpy.ops.render.render.description: Current scene camera CPU raster preview; write_still False/True, resolution percentage and pixel aspect, PNG output up to 2048 pixels per axis. No animation/viewport overrides, Blender pixel parity or persistent Render Result datablock

bpy.types.ArrayModifier.end_cap.description: Different evaluated mesh object or None, placed one offset after the last copy; ignores cap object transform and uses source material slots

bpy.types.ArrayModifier.merge_threshold.description: Float distance 0..1, default 0.01; at most two million proximity checks and two million evaluated vertices/faces

bpy.types.ArrayModifier.offset_object.description: Offset object or None; transforms may rotate, scale or reflect copies

bpy.types.ArrayModifier.start_cap.description: Different evaluated mesh object or None, placed one offset before the source; ignores cap object transform and uses source material slots

bpy.types.ArrayModifier.use_merge_vertic.description: Weld adjacent copies and caps within merge_threshold; retain target coordinates and corner attributes; remove collapsed/duplicate faces
Also weld first and last copies when merging is enabled

bpy.types.ArrayModifier.use_object_offse.description: Compose owner-relative offset object affine transform with relative/constant translation

bpy.types.ArrayModifier.use_relative_off.description: Enable offset relative to evaluated mesh bounding box

bpy.types.BevelModifier.affect.description: EDGES on closed convex polyhedral meshes; EDGES/VERTICES on canonical cuboids; textured VERTICES requires one or even segments

bpy.types.BevelModifier.limit_method.description: NONE/ANGLE on closed convex polyhedral meshes; coplanar edges remain unchanged

bpy.types.BevelModifier.segments.description: Rounded edge segments 1..8; general convex meshes use sampled fillets and corner patches, with per-face UV projection; canonical cuboids retain reference stencils and their UV restrictions

bpy.types.BevelModifier.use_clamp_overla.description: True clamps general mesh width before face insets collapse; canonical cuboids retain half-shortest-edge clamping; False rejects overlapping width

bpy.types.BevelModifier.width.description: Nonnegative OFFSET bevel distance; oversized widths clamp when use_clamp_overlap=True

bpy.types.BezierSplinePoint.co.description: Live three-component coordinate within +/-10000; moving the control point translates both stored handles

bpy.types.BezierSplinePoint.handle_left.description: Live left handle coordinate within +/-10000; FREE/ALIGNED handles are explicit

bpy.types.BezierSplinePoint.handle_left_.description: FREE, VECTOR, AUTO or ALIGNED; ordinary 3D AUTO uses the neighbor chord bisector and Blender length convention, reference-tested on corner and unequal-spacing cases

bpy.types.BezierSplinePoint.handle_right.description: Live right handle coordinate within +/-10000; FREE/ALIGNED handles are explicit
FREE, VECTOR, AUTO or ALIGNED; moving a handle aligns its opposite ALIGNED handle unless either handle is FREE

bpy.types.BezierSplinePoint.radius.description: Radius multiplier 0..100, linearly interpolated along each span

bpy.types.BezierSplinePoint.tilt.description: Tilt radians +/-100, linearly interpolated along each span

bpy.types.BooleanModifier.collection.description: Collection operand or None; recursive membership, evaluated in owner local coordinates; removing the collection clears references

bpy.types.BooleanModifier.object.description: Mesh object operand or None; evaluated in owner local coordinates

bpy.types.BooleanModifier.operand_type.description: OBJECT or COLLECTION; at most 64 recursive mesh operands, owner excluded; collection INTERSECT requires EXACT or MANIFOLD

bpy.types.BooleanModifier.operation.description: DIFFERENCE, UNION or INTERSECT of closed manifold meshes

bpy.types.BooleanModifier.solver.description: EXACT, FAST or MANIFOLD on closed oriented solids; shared robust kernel, canonical boundary topology; coplanar partition and collinear vertices may differ; reflected transforms require EXACT/FAST

bpy.types.Camera.type.description: PERSP or ORTHO; panoramic cameras fail explicitly

bpy.types.CloudsTexture.evaluate.description: Evaluate cell-noise texture at local coordinates

bpy.types.Curve.bevel_depth.description: Finite 0..100; zero depth preserves wire geometry

bpy.types.Curve.copy.description: Independent control data and evaluated geometry copy

bpy.types.Curve.extrude.description: Zero only; additional profile extrusion excluded

bpy.types.Curve.materials.description: Material slots: iteration, indexing, assignment, append/clear/pop

bpy.types.Curve.materials.clear.description: Clear slots and reset spline material indices

bpy.types.Curve.name.description: UTF-8 datablock name, independent mesh/curve namespaces

bpy.types.Curve.resolution_u.description: Integer 1..1024; samples each curved Bezier span, leaves POLY and VECTOR spans linear

bpy.types.Curve.splines.description: At most 64 POLY/BEZIER splines; integer indexing and iteration

bpy.types.Curve.splines.new.description: new(type=POLY or BEZIER), initially one point

bpy.types.Curve.twist_mode.description: MINIMUM only; spatial cyclic paths distribute residual frame twist by arc length

bpy.types.Curve.use_fill_caps.description: Close open nonzero-radius beveled splines with flat end caps; cyclic splines have no end caps

bpy.types.DisplaceModifier.invert_vertex.description: Invert vertex-group influence as 1-weight; ignored when the named group is absent

bpy.types.DisplaceModifier.vertex_group.description: Vertex-group name controlling displacement strength; missing or empty name means full influence

bpy.types.FloatAttribute.data.description: Per-element values through index or iteration

bpy.types.FloatAttribute.domain.description: EDGE or POINT according to the crease attribute

bpy.types.FloatAttributeValue.value.description: Read/write finite float32 crease value in 0..1

bpy.types.FloatColorAttribute.data.description: Read/write corner values through index or iteration

bpy.types.FloatColorAttributeValue.color.description: Four finite scene-linear RGBA components; indexed writes and whole-vector assignment

bpy.types.Image.pixels.description: Flat RGBA sequence supporting whole-property and indexed/slice assignment

bpy.types.IntAttribute.data.description: One value per polygon, accessed by index or iteration

bpy.types.Key.key_blocks.description: Read ordered shape-key collection by index or name

bpy.types.Light.shape.description: AREA emitter shape: SQUARE, RECTANGLE, DISK or ELLIPSE

bpy.types.Material.diffuse_color.description: Viewport RGBA, independent of node inputs

bpy.types.Material.node_tree.description: None until nodes are enabled; retained when disabled

bpy.types.Material.node_tree.links.new.description: Connect permitted UV/Mapping/Image, Image Color to Principled Base Color or Emission Color, Image Alpha to Alpha, and Principled to output; existing Normal Map chain retained

bpy.types.Material.node_tree.nodes.description: Single Principled/output, image textures and one UV TexCoord/POINT Mapping chain; existing Normal Map retained

bpy.types.Material.users.description: Number of mesh slots referencing the material

bpy.types.Mesh.color_attributes.description: One FLOAT_COLOR CORNER attribute; indexing, iteration and length

bpy.types.Mesh.color_attributes.get.description: Find the single corner color attribute by name

bpy.types.Mesh.color_attributes.new.description: new(name,type,domain): one FLOAT_COLOR CORNER attribute with a name of 1..63 UTF-8 bytes

bpy.types.Mesh.copy.description: Copy mesh geometry and material references

bpy.types.Mesh.has_custom_normals.description: Whether stored custom corner normals are present

bpy.types.Mesh.materials.description: Material slots: append, clear, pop, indexed access and assignment

bpy.types.MeshPolygon.loop_indices.description: Read-only range of corner indices in this polygon

bpy.types.MeshUVLoop.uv.description: UV pair, assignment and indexed access

bpy.types.MeshVertex.co.description: XYZ coordinate; assignment and indexed access

bpy.types.MirrorModifier.mirror_offset_u.description: -1..1 additional offset when U reflection is enabled

bpy.types.MirrorModifier.mirror_offset_v.description: -1..1 additional offset when V reflection is enabled

bpy.types.MirrorModifier.use_clip.description: Edit-mode clipping flag; no effect on object-mode evaluation

bpy.types.MirrorModifier.use_mirror_vert.description: Swap matching side names and average seam weights, default True

bpy.types.NodeSocket.default_value.description: Named Blender 4.5 default-mode Principled scalar/color/radius inputs, including IOR and Transmission Weight: float32 storage, unclamped scalar values, nonnegative RGBA colors. Normal/Tangent/Coat Normal are read-only; hidden Weight/Subsurface IOR excluded. Background color/strength, planar Mapping Location/Rotation/Scale and existing Normal Map strength. Extra scattering inputs persist in hb/glTF extras; fixed preview shading is unchanged.

bpy.types.Object.copy.description: Copy object, sharing its data and retaining transforms

bpy.types.Object.data.description: Shared mesh, camera or light data block; None for an empty

bpy.types.Object.dimensions.description: Evaluated local bounding-box dimensions multiplied by world-axis scale; assignment preserves scale signs.

bpy.types.Object.empty_display_size.description: Persistent empty display radius, clamped at 0.0001.

bpy.types.Object.empty_display_type.description: Persistent empty display shape, excluding image empties.

bpy.types.Object.location.description: XYZ float32 transform; assignment, indexed read/write, iteration

bpy.types.Object.location.x.description: Component access on transform views (see type deviation)

bpy.types.Object.matrix_world.description: Read a 4x4 world-matrix snapshot; assign affine matrices with finite input/basis components within 1e6 through parent-inverse and TRS decomposition; six Euler orders or quaternion; nonsingular effective parent required; nested snapshot mutation does not write the object

bpy.types.Object.mode.description: Read OBJECT or EDIT for the transient single edit object

bpy.types.Object.modifiers.description: Ordered non-destructive stack; ARRAY/MIRROR/SOLIDIFY/TRIANGULATE and bounded BEVEL subsets

bpy.types.Object.modifiers.new.description: new(name, type): ARRAY, MIRROR, SOLIDIFY, TRIANGULATE, restricted WELD or restricted BEVEL

bpy.types.Object.modifiers.remove.description: Remove a modifier from this object

bpy.types.Object.scale.description: XYZ float32 scale; assignment, indexed read/write, iteration

bpy.types.Object.type.description: MESH, CAMERA, LIGHT or EMPTY according to data block

bpy.types.Object.users.description: Number of collection memberships (parent and scene-camera pointers do not increment ID users)

bpy.types.Object.vertex_groups.description: Named vertex groups on a mesh object; at most 1024 groups

bpy.types.Object.vertex_groups.get.description: Lookup a group by name with an optional fallback

bpy.types.Object.vertex_groups.new.description: new(name=Group), unique UTF-8 names with Blender numeric suffixes

bpy.types.Object.vertex_groups.remove.description: Remove one group and reindex mesh deform memberships

bpy.types.ShaderNode.image.description: Image Texture or World Environment Texture image datablock

bpy.types.ShaderNode.interpolation.description: Image and Environment Texture: Linear only

bpy.types.ShaderNode.projection.description: Environment Texture EQUIRECTANGULAR or Image Texture FLAT only

bpy.types.ShapeKeyPoint.co.description: Read/write finite float32 3D shape coordinate and components

bpy.types.SolidifyModifier.shell_vertex_.description: Existing group receiving generated inner-shell memberships at weight one

bpy.types.Spline.bezier_points.description: BEZIER control points; indexing/iteration, at most 4096 points

bpy.types.SubsurfModifier.use_limit_surf.description: Evaluate the limit surface or finite refinement

bpy.types.TextCurve.align_x.description: LEFT, CENTER or RIGHT using full line advance

bpy.types.TextCurve.body.description: At most 256 printable ASCII characters and newlines; nonempty text requires an explicitly loaded font; default Bfont rendering excluded

bpy.types.TextCurve.extrude.description: Finite 0..100 extrusion on each side of Z=0; total thickness 2*extrude independent of size; closed caps and hole walls; zero preserves flat geometry

bpy.types.TextCurve.font.description: Assign loaded VectorFont; geometry persists without the source font file

bpy.types.TextCurve.materials.description: Material slots; text caps and extrusion walls use slot zero

bpy.types.TextCurve.resolution_u.description: Quadratic outline sampling resolution 1..32; linear contour edges stay linear

bpy.types.TextCurve.size.description: Finite 0.0001..100 font size, normalized by font bounding-box height

bpy.types.TriangulateModifier.keep_custo.description: True preserves corner normals; False remaps encoded corner normals on flat planar faces; smooth custom normals require True

bpy.types.TriangulateModifier.ngon_metho.description: BEAUTY or CLIP on planar simple n-gons with 3..2048 corners

bpy.types.TriangulateModifier.quad_metho.description: BEAUTY, FIXED, FIXED_ALTERNATE, SHORTEST_DIAGONAL, LONGEST_DIAGONAL; BEAUTY requires planar simple faces

bpy.types.VectorFont.name.description: Loaded font family/style name with ordinary unique datablock suffixes; default unbundled font name Bfont

bpy.types.VectorFont.users.description: Number of FONT curve datablocks referencing the loaded font

bpy.types.VertexGroup.add.description: Assign valid vertex indices with REPLACE/ADD/SUBTRACT, weights clamped to 0..1

bpy.types.VertexGroup.remove.description: Remove memberships from valid vertex indices

bpy.types.VertexGroup.weight.description: Read a vertex weight; RuntimeError for a vertex outside this group

bpy.types.View3DCursor.location.description: Three finite float32 cursor coordinates; default location for primitive construction

bpy.types.View3DCursor.rotation_euler.description: Three finite XYZ cursor Euler angles; default rotation for CURSOR alignment

bpy.types.WeightedNormalModifier.invert_.description: Invert membership filtering; weight magnitude does not scale normals

bpy.types.WeightedNormalModifier.keep_sh.description: Keep separate smooth fans at flat/smooth and nonmanifold boundaries

bpy.types.WeightedNormalModifier.use_fac.description: Use strongest adjacent faces from __mod_weightednormals_faceweight INT FACE (0/1/2)

bpy.types.WeightedNormalModifier.vertex_.description: Named membership filter, including zero-weight members; missing group leaves all vertices selected

bpy.types.WeldModifier.invert_vertex_gro.description: Select zero or missing group weights; merged memberships are averaged and zero merged memberships removed

bpy.types.WeldModifier.loose_edges.description: In CONNECTED mode restrict collapse to edges unused by faces; ignored in ALL mode

bpy.types.WeldModifier.merge_threshold.description: Local float32 distance; ALL uses strict spatial-partition bounds and zero is a no-op; CONNECTED includes equality and coincident vertices at zero

bpy.types.WeldModifier.mode.description: ALL greedy proximity groups or CONNECTED edge collapse with updated cluster centers; averaged positions and collapsed/pinched/duplicate-face cleanup

bpy.types.WeldModifier.show_viewport.description: Viewport query and glTF export evaluation flag

bpy.types.WeldModifier.vertex_group.description: Select vertices with nonzero group weight; missing/empty group means all vertices; weights do not scale distance

bpy.types.World.copy.description: Copy persistent World color, nodes and links; image datablocks remain shared

bpy.types.World.node_tree.description: Persistent Background color/strength and one EQUIRECTANGULAR/Linear Environment Texture; existing World Output wiring. Preview uses constant illumination and the environment solid-angle mean; no directional environment shading.

bpy.types.World.node_tree.links.new.description: Environment Color to Background Color; Background to World Output Surface; replaces the input's prior link

bpy.types.World.node_tree.nodes.description: Named World node lookup, iteration and length

bpy.types.World.node_tree.nodes.get.description: Look up a World node by name

bpy.types.World.node_tree.nodes.new.description: One each: ShaderNodeBackground, ShaderNodeOutputWorld, ShaderNodeTexEnvironment; other World nodes raise UnsupportedError

bpy.types.World.use_nodes.description: Read/write node usage; first enable creates Background from world.color; disabling retains nodes and selects constant-color lighting

hb.export.obj.description: CLI hb export and run --out .obj: evaluated linked meshes in Z-up meters, reflected winding, UV/normal corner indices, scalar MTL and PNG image companions; per-file atomic output, preserve revision

hb.export.usdz.description: CLI USDZ: aligned uncompressed USDA/PNG archive, evaluated linked meshes, hierarchy, face materials, UVs/normals/colors, perspective and standard-unit orthographic cameras (warns about Blender 4.5 10x ortho import); POINT/SPOT/SUN/AREA lights; generated float images use 16-bit PNG, byte images 8-bit; warns that World environments are omitted

hb.import.meshopt.description: EXT_meshopt_compression for glTF/GLB import: ATTRIBUTES/TRIANGLES/INDICES and NONE/OCTAHEDRAL/QUATERNION/EXPONENTIAL; standard 0xa0/0xe1/0xd1 streams, tagged or untagged required fallback buffers; parent/source layout validation; 32 MiB per compressed/decoded view and 64 MiB decoded total; no encoding, COLOR filter or additional geometry/animation parity

hb.import.ply.description: CLI PLY 1.0 ASCII/little-endian/big-endian: standard 8/16/32-bit integer and float32/64 scalar/list types, XYZ vertices, polygon faces, loose edges, vertex s/t UVs, nonzero normals and uchar/float RGB(A) sRGB conversion; bounded cleanup, warns for ignored attributes; 32 MiB, 100,000 rows/element, 2048 corners/face, four million scalar values

hb.import.stl.description: CLI ASCII and little-endian binary STL: exact-length binary detection including solid headers, finite float32 XYZ in Z-up meters, geometric normals, exact-coordinate welding and duplicate/repeated-vertex triangle cleanup; 100,000 triangles/vertices, 32 MiB input; no facet-normal override or nonstandard facet colors

mathutils.Color.description: Float32 RGB sequence with Color arithmetic and scalar multiply/divide; default black

mathutils.Color.freeze.description: Freeze an unwrapped Color and return itself

mathutils.Color.from_aces_to_scene_linea.description: ACES AP0 to factory scene-linear RGB

mathutils.Color.from_rec709_linear_to_sc.description: Linear Rec.709 to factory scene-linear RGB

mathutils.Color.from_scene_linear_to_ace.description: Factory scene-linear RGB to ACES AP0

mathutils.Color.from_scene_linear_to_rec.description: Factory scene-linear RGB to linear Rec.709

mathutils.Color.from_scene_linear_to_srg.description: Factory scene-linear matrix plus measured fast sRGB transfer behavior; positive linear components up to 1e10

mathutils.Color.from_scene_linear_to_xyz.description: Factory scene-linear RGB to CIE XYZ D65

mathutils.Color.from_srgb_to_scene_linea.description: sRGB transfer decoding plus factory scene-linear matrix

mathutils.Color.from_xyz_d65_to_scene_li.description: CIE XYZ D65 to factory scene-linear RGB

mathutils.Color.hsv.description: HSV tuple; assignments clamp all three components to 0..1

mathutils.Color.owner.description: Owning RNA value or None for standalone colors

mathutils.Euler.description: Mutable float32 Euler angles, six rotation orders

mathutils.Matrix.description: Float32 storage with 2..4 rows and 2..4 columns; row read/write, copies, resizing and dimension-compatible Matrix/Vector multiplication. 2x4 @ 3D is excluded (undefined Blender result): use a four-component vector. Nonsquare determinant/inversion/transpose raise ValueError.

mathutils.Matrix.decompose.description: 4x4 finite components up to magnitude 1e6: location Vector, quaternion and signed scale Vector, including shears, reflections and zero-scale columns. Blender column normalization and quaternion pivot semantics; 2e-6 differential tolerance.

mathutils.Quaternion.description: Float32 quaternion from components or axis and angle

mathutils.Quaternion.slerp.description: Quaternion and factor in [0,1]; finite components up to magnitude 1e6. Blender shortest-arc sign convention, no implicit operand/result normalization; zero and nonunit inputs tested.

mathutils.Vector.description: Mutable 2D/3D/4D float32 vector; default is zero 3D

mathutils.Vector.angle.description: Angle in radians, with optional fallback for zero vectors

mathutils.Vector.normalize.description: Normalize in place; zero vector remains zero

mathutils.Vector.to_track_quat.description: Track signed local axis toward vector with world Z as up; quaternion signs are rotation-equivalent
